title: Users
description: People with access to this product: its operators and the members of its tenants.

empty.title: No users yet
empty.body: Users appear here once they are members of this product or one of its tenants.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different search or status filter.

detail.disableBody: {{name}} can no longer sign in and all sessions end immediately. Memberships stay. API keys the user created stop working until the user is enabled again.
detail.disabledNotice: This user is disabled and cannot sign in.
detail.revokeBody: All sessions of {{name}} end immediately. The user can sign in again.
detail.profileDescription: Memberships are managed on each tenant's Members tab.
detail.noEmailInfo: This user signs in only through single sign-on and cannot accept invitations, which are bound to an email address. Add the user to tenants directly instead.
detail.noEmailAbout: About users without an email address

help.none: Access only through product and tenant memberships.
help.platform_viewer: Read-only access to every product, the settings and the installation-wide audit log.
help.platform_admin: Full control of the whole installation, including all products and users.

platformRole.title: Platform role
platformRole.confirmBody: {{name}} gets the platform role “{{role}}”. This changes access to every product on this server.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.description: Products where the user is an operator and tenants where the user is a member, as far as you may see them. Roles are changed on each product's or tenant's Members tab.
memberships.noProducts: No product roles you can see
memberships.noTenants: No tenant memberships you can see

identities.title: Single sign-on identities
identities.description: Accounts at identity providers that sign in as this user. Each one is identified by the provider's issuer and the subject, the user's ID at the provider.
identities.providerHelp: Choose a configured provider or enter its issuer URL exactly as the server configures it.
identities.providerHelpFree: The identity provider's issuer URL, exactly as the server's single sign-on settings name it.
identities.providerInfo: Axentra matches a sign-in by issuer and subject. A value that differs only slightly (for example a missing slash at the end) creates an identity that never signs in.
identities.subject: Subject
identities.subjectHelp: The user's ID at the provider (the sub claim), not the email address.
identities.emptyPassword: This user signs in with a password.
identities.linkDescription: The user can then sign in with this account at the provider. Use it to correct accounts after a migration or an import.
identities.unlinkBody: {{name}} can no longer sign in with this account at {{provider}}, and all of the user's sessions end immediately. The user's last way to sign in cannot be unlinked.

external.title: Add a single sign-on user
external.description: Creates an account that signs in through an identity provider, for migrations and imports. The user gets no password and no memberships: add the user to tenants afterwards.
external.nameHelp: Optional. Shown in Studio and in member lists.
external.emailHelp: Leave it empty for a user without an email address.
external.emailInfo: The address becomes the user's email address only if the provider verified it. Otherwise the user has no address and the value is only kept on the identity for reference. Users without an address cannot accept invitations.
external.verifiedHelp: Tick it only if the identity provider confirmed that the address belongs to this user.
